description: One typed FACTUAL global-inequality indicator value, ingested by narashi_metric_ingest from a pre-published World Bank WDI / UN SDG / Our World in Data snapshot. R0 skeleton per ADR-2607101800 §3/§6. CONSTITUTIONAL: describes a disclosed statistic only — it MUST NOT rank jurisdictions as good/bad or assign merit (G4 non-adjudicating). `indicator` is a closed, DESCRIPTIVE enum with no merit/ranking value. `sourceRecordCids` MUST contain >=2 upstream WDI/SDG/OWID record CIDs unless `singleSourced=true` (G5). Persisted in kotoba EAVT (G2; NO RisingWave/Postgres/Lance).

sourceCellDid.description: DID of the narashi cell that ingested this observation (narashi_metric_ingest)

indicator.description: DESCRIPTIVE indicator identifier ONLY. No merit/ranking value exists (G4).

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3 country code, or a WDI/UN region/income-group aggregate code (e.g. WLD, LMY)

value.description: Decimal string (avoids float drift). The reported figure as published by the source.

sourceRecordCids.description: >=2 upstream record CIDs (G5); exactly 1 permitted only when singleSourced=true

singleSourced.description: true when only one Tier-A source publishes this indicator-jurisdiction-period triple (explicit, not silent, per G5)

methodNoteCid.description: narashi.methodNote record CID defining the open, versioned normalization heuristic (G6)
